# gnomAD_DB

> gnomAD_DB is a Python package that converts the massive gnomAD (Genome Aggregation Database) VCF files (~120GB per chromosome) into a compact, queryable SQLite database (<100GB total). It enables fast lookups of variant annotations including allele frequency, depth, and population-specific metrics.

## Key Facts

- Converts gnomAD VCF files into SQLite for fast querying
- Query 300,000 variants in ~40 seconds
- Extracts 23 variant annotations per variant
- Supports gnomAD v2.1.1 (hg19), v3.1.2 (hg38), v4.0 (hg38), v4.1 (hg38)
- Supports both WGS and WES databases
- Pre-built SQLite databases available on Zenodo (no need to process VCFs yourself)
- Installable via pip: `pip install gnomad_db`
- MIT licensed, Python 3.8+

## When to Use gnomAD_DB

- You need to annotate genetic variants with gnomAD allele frequencies
- You want to query gnomAD without downloading and parsing 120GB+ VCF files per chromosome
- You need fast batch lookups of minor allele frequency (MAF), allele count, or population-specific frequencies
- You want a local, offline gnomAD query solution without API rate limits

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/KalinNonchev/gnomAD_DB
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/gnomad-db/
- Pre-built databases (Zenodo):
  - WGS gnomAD v4.1 (hg38, 759M variants): https://zenodo.org/records/11077663
  - WES gnomAD v4.1 (hg38, 184M variants): https://zenodo.org/records/11076395
  - WGS gnomAD v3.1.2 (hg38, 759M variants): https://zenodo.org/records/6818606
  - WGS gnomAD v2.1.1 (hg19, 262M variants): https://zenodo.org/records/5770384

## Installation

```
pip install gnomad_db
```

## Quick Start

```python
import pandas as pd
from gnomad_db.database import gnomAD_DB

# Initialize with pre-downloaded SQLite database
db = gnomAD_DB("path/to/database", gnomad_version="v4")

# Query allele frequency for variants
variants = pd.DataFrame({
    "chrom": ["1", "21"],
    "pos": [21, 9825790],
    "ref": ["T", "C"],
    "alt": ["G", "T"]
})
db.get_info_from_df(variants, "AF")

# Query from string
db.get_info_from_str("21:9825790:C>T", "AF")

# Query interval
db.get_info_for_interval(chrom=21, interval_start=9825780, interval_end=9825799, query="AF")
```

## Citation

Nonchev, K. (2021). gnomAD_DB: Scalable SQLite Database for gnomAD VCF Files. GitHub. https://github.com/KalinNonchev/gnomAD_DB
